requirements.reason: Firebase UID must be the stable provider-to-local linkage key while PostgreSQL users.id remains the stable Pickup Lane identity.
Simultaneous first login must create one local user through current PostgreSQL uniqueness and conflict handling.
Provisioning must create and repair exactly one UserSettings row and one UserStats row for each local user.
Same-UID repeat sync may refresh provider snapshots and repair context rows but must preserve local identity and lifecycle authority.
A different Firebase UID with the same email snapshot must not take over, merge into, or relink an existing local account.
Local account lifecycle states must remain PostgreSQL authority and must be enforced on new protected requests.
Account deletion must distinguish safe local/provider failure states, support follow-up, auth-link handling, and no blind retry.
Repository-owned recovery, sign-in, and provider-side linking source must not expose account-not-found distinctions or local takeover authority.
New protected requests must use current PostgreSQL role/account state rather than process-local account or role cache authority.
Repository-owned local admin mutation paths must prevent removal of the final active local administrator.
Active source inventory must fail closed for lifecycle, recovery, and admin bypasses in the WS03-02-owned boundary.
External provider/runtime/operations facts cannot be closed by local WS03-02 pytest and must have zero pytest mappings.
